watches.name: TXN42
watches.description: Bold colors. Houston Texans spirit. Built to last. The TXN42 brings the Battle Red and Deep Steel Blue of Houston Texans pride to your wrist, wrapped in a case built for everyday precision. This is a watch for anyone who wants their gear to say something — sharp enough for the office, bold enough for game day. Powered by a Citizen Miyota automatic movement, the TXN42 needs no battery — just regular wear keeps it running. A 41mm all-stainless-steel case houses an Ultraview sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, so the dial stays crisp and legible in any light. At 10.5mm thick, it sits comfortably under a cuff without feeling bulky. Rated 20ATM (660 ft) water resistant, the TXN42 is built for real life, not just display. It ships with two interchangeable 22mm straps — a polished stainless steel bracelet and a sport silicone strap — so you can switch between dress and casual in seconds. New to automatic watches? See how they compare to quartz before you decide. Specs at a glance: Case: All stainless steel, 41mm, 10.5mm thick Crystal: Ultraview sapphire, anti-reflective coating Movement: Citizen Miyota automatic Water resistance: 20ATM (660 ft) Strap: 22mm, two interchangeable bands (stainless steel + silicone) Features: Date display, anti-reflective, interchangeable strap

watches.name: Space City
watches.description: A tribute to the city that never stops moving. The Space City automatic is Logic Watches' salute to Houston — where ambition meets ease, and precision engineering feels right at home whether you're closing a deal downtown or unwinding on the weekend. Built on a 316 stainless steel case with a high-gloss ceramic bezel, Space City pairs a sapphire crystal face with a reliable NH35 automatic movement — no batteries, ever. Just wind it, wear it, and let it run. The date function keeps you on schedule, and 20ATM water resistance means it's ready for more than just the boardroom. Space City ships with two interchangeable straps, so you can switch the look in seconds to match the occasion — sharp for the office, relaxed for the weekend. New to automatic watches? See how they compare to quartz before you decide. Specs at a glance: Case: 316 stainless steel, 40mm Bezel: High-gloss ceramic Crystal: Ultra-View sapphire Movement: NH35 automatic Water resistance: Waterproof Strap: 20mm, two interchangeable bands included Features: Date display, interchangeable strap
